remarks: Experience modern city living and enjoy glorious sunrises from this 16th floor, 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo with over 800 sq ft of living space, one of the larger 1 bed floorplans. The main living area is open plan with plenty of room. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops and a breakfast bar. The bedroom has a walk-in closet. There are full width windows in the living room and bedroom which flood the unit with light. The Biltmore is a premier high-rise condominium, residents enjoy a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, shuttle service, community room, laundry room, storage, 4th-flr courtyard, dry cleaning, and a pet-friendly environment. Secure garage parking is available for $115/pm per car. This condo offers the easy access to all that Stamford has to offer.
